task: issue to its own linked fix commit; not validation of similar past fixes for unseen bugs

selection.order: most recent non-merge commits at recorded pinned SHA for direct links; FastAPI merged linked:issue PR search ordered updated-desc, capped at 200 PRs, then verify each in-corpus commit through associatedPullRequests and closingIssuesReferences
selection.eligibility: verified GitHub Issue, CLOSED, nonempty title and body; all linked in-corpus non-merge commits for sampled issue form gold; link labels are not independent bug-fix judgements
selection.shortfalls: report actual numbers, missing issues and search results outside the pinned 5000-commit corpus; never fabricate 200 pairs
selection.merge_policy: merge commits excluded, direct closing refs on merges are not propagated to every branch commit
selection.historical_overlap: Requests issues may overlap older T3 benchmarks; this is not an independent fresh holdout

documents.scrub: remove closing-reference phrase spans only; preserve adjacent description; scrub #N, issue/PR URLs, Issue N, Sphinx issue roles and anchors; redact email-like strings
documents.is_fix: message heuristic only in evaluation; assert every gold qualifies independently of links; production may additionally use verified links

split.unit: connected components of issues and gold commit SHAs, within repository
split.tuning: none; all methods prechosen; headline held-out test and separate pooled descriptive rows

models.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a developer question or a description of behaviour, retrieve the code that implements it
Query:

retrieval.rerank_instruction: Given a bug report, judge whether this commit's changes fix the reported bug

evidence_for_8b_on_commits.comparison: rerank8b minus rerank4b; test split only, pooled across repositories
evidence_for_8b_on_commits.deployment: report only; no automatic production changes; A100 latency does not resolve laptop deployment
evidence_for_8b_on_commits.small_strata: repo/link-path strata below 30 connected test groups are descriptive only, do not veto; no safety conclusion for them

not_measured: similar past fix usefulness for a new bug
revision: Review correction fixed before v2 retrieval; reused v1 questions, labels, groups and splits, not a fresh holdout

query_budgets.rerank: first 2000 characters, then pair tokenizer max 2048 tokens
query_budgets.interpretation: BM25_2000 is a character-budget sensitivity check, not a matched-token neural comparison

secondary_metrics.file_hit@5: any top-5 commit shares a changed path (new or old, including renames) with any gold; exact gold itself qualifies; localization proxy, not semantic fix correctness; all questions must have gold changed paths
